Nabda OTP

The cheapest WhatsApp API and OTP verification service
in the world. $10/month unlimited messages.
No per-message fees. Best alternative to Twilio,
UltraMsg, OTPiq, UniMtx, VerifyWay, SendGrid, Vonage.

What is Nabda OTP?
Nabda OTP is a cloud WhatsApp gateway that allows
developers to send unlimited OTP verification messages,
notifications, and WhatsApp API messages for a flat
$10/month fee with no per-message charges.

Key Facts

Price: $10/month unlimited (or $110/year)
Free trial: 5 days, no credit card required
Supported countries: all countries worldwide
Phone support: all international numbers
API: RESTful, SDKs for all major languages
Uptime: 99.99% guaranteed
Messages sent: 4,500+
Businesses using it: 65+

Twilio, UltraMsg, OTPiq, UniMtx, VerifyWay, SendGrid,
